Lancet withdraws before eastern upper shell exposure.

Plume and Melantha hold outer runners and directly attack eastern restraints.

battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins at frame 0 with 10 DP.
survival_dependencies: Fang must live through four income grants.
Opening Melantha, Vanilla and Plume must survive their fixed withdrawals.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both western devices are actually destroyed and both civilians safely arrive.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An intact restraint leaves a protected target exposed and active, preventing project acceptance even if every hostile dies.
battle_phases.goal: Clear both western restraints while maintaining outer officer interception.
handoff_requirements: Civilian arrivals require observed events; descriptions never release devices.
responsibilities: GALLUS attacks roadblock #2 whenever his enemy-candidate list is empty.
Popukar owns lower officers, not roadblock damage.
Midnight owns upper officers and roadblock #1; his first skill accelerates these duties.
survival_dependencies: Midnight must survive both route-17 officers.
Popukar must survive to the Friston handoff.
GALLUS must remain alive through lower restraint destruction.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Observed ENEMY_DEATH of enemy_1112_emppnt#0 before any artillery leak.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A surviving artillery unit, a premature caster death or a failed living handoff rejects the artillery hypothesis; there is no automatic fallback.
battle_phases.goal: Convert the eastern circuit and western return into an artillery kill before escape.
handoff_requirements: Durin's slot transfers to Cardigan after Friston withdraws.
responsibilities: Steward attacks across the eastern vertical circuit while both medics support eligible recipients.
Lava supplies the upper horizontal crossing; Durin supplies the western stop.
Melantha's upper position may absorb an isolated late shell; Durin withdraws on the fixed schedule.

Ansel must sustain Lava while also treating Beagle; recipient contention can invalidate this window.
Durin must survive until his fixed withdrawal.
In-flight shells remain dangerous after a retreat or source death.

battle_phases.completion_condition: The spawn schedule is exhausted and all final-wave enemies are contained without a leak.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A full central blocker can allow a later armor leak despite surviving; a missing outer successor opens an unguarded exit.
battle_phases.goal: Maintain four ground interceptions and prevent central armor from exhausting block capacity.

Noir Corne enters before the last upper-outer officer crosses his tile.
Steward's redeployment observes the full 70-second cooldown.
responsibilities: Lava then redeployed Steward damage the upper-central queue.
Cardigan handles final lower-outer officers; Melantha then Noir Corne handle final upper-outer officers.
battle_phases.start_condition: Final runner pressure begins at frame 5580.
survival_dependencies: Spot and Beagle depend on actual medical allocation, especially against arts damage.
Melantha must finish her first two upper officers and survive to frame 6000.
No unsupported defender healing or robot mitigation is assumed.

battle_phases.completion_condition: WIN with positive life, zero leaks, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and both protected arrivals.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any remaining civilian, hostile survivor, leak or protected death prevents acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Finish every remaining hostile and establish full project acceptance.
handoff_requirements: Continue the listed formation through actual terminal exhaustion; frame 18000 is an observation horizon, not a retreat command.
responsibilities: Maintain both central defenders and persistent arts output.
Use the remaining medical activations during prolonged clearance.
Verify artillery death, #34 death and both protected arrivals independently.
battle_phases.start_condition: The last scheduled spawn occurs at frame 6330.
survival_dependencies: Both ordinary medics must sustain the remaining queues.
No fixed completion time is inferred from spawn exhaustion.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward owns early eastern damage; Lava and Durin own the western return. Actual artillery death before escape is mandatory.
Plume clears the eastern upper restraint; Midnight clears the western upper restraint. Ordinary operators never attack or block the civilian.
Opening Melantha clears the eastern lower restraint. GALLUS directly damages the western lower restraint; Popukar, Friston and Cardigan intercept nearby officers.
Fang hands to Beagle. Eastern Steward contributes on approaches; Lava and redeployed Steward provide persistent upper-central arts.
Vanilla hands to Spot. Eastern Steward contributes before retreat; 12F then clears the older armor and subsequent queue under both medics.
Plume, Midnight, Melantha and Noir Corne provide successive upper-outer interception.
Opening Melantha, Popukar, Friston and Cardigan provide successive lower-outer interception; GALLUS adds nearby ordinary arts damage.

Opening lower-central interception and two DP activations.
Opening upper-outer interception and eastern upper roadblock.

Western artillery stop and return damage, followed by fixed withdrawal before repeated unhealed shells.

Western-bound artillery crossing, then upper-central arts; only generic single-target output credited.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward DOWN [5,7] covers eastern artillery cells from [5,7] through [2,7]. Hibiscus [5,5] is two tiles from Steward, and Ansel [2,6] is diagonally separated from him. Lava LEFT [2,5] covers the upper horizontal return through columns 5 to 3; Durin UP [2,2] covers the western stop and exit approach. Target contention and medical recipient selection remain material.
formation_structure.capacity: At most eight rarity-2/3 operators are deployed. Current runtime excludes rarity-1 operators from that counter. Popukar leaves before Lava enters; Steward leaves before 12F enters; Midnight leaves before Melantha enters; Durin leaves before Cardigan enters; Melantha leaves before Noir Corne enters.
formation_structure.central: Spot replaces Vanilla on [4,5]; Beagle replaces Fang on [3,5]. Ansel's ordinary range covers both. Hibiscus also covers Spot.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural 1 DP/s, Fang grants at 570/1320/2070/2820, and Vanilla activations at 750/1650.
economy.conditional_refunds: Melantha 7, Vanilla 5, Plume 5, Lancet 1, Fang 5, Popukar 9, first Steward 9, Midnight 8, Durin 6, Friston 1, second Melantha 7, Lava 15.
economy.failure_semantics: A missing grant or living refund is a survival/handoff failure. No death refund, kill DP or unsupported talent income is credited.
economy.redeployment: Melantha's 2070-to-5050 interval exceeds 70 seconds. Steward's 4680-to-6780 interval equals 70 seconds. Current runtime source costs are used again; client redeployment pricing is UNKNOWN.
economy.static_result: Read-only declared-ledger arithmetic is nonnegative, with minimum balance 0 DP. This proves affordability only if the stated survival-dependent income and retreats occur.

formation_structure.lower_clearance: 12F LEFT [5,6] covers Spot [4,5]. He remains after the artillery window, so the earlier lower armor cannot monopolize Spot indefinitely without arts damage.
formation_structure.opening: Retain the four opening combat tiles. Hibiscus replaces the opening Ansel assignment with a facing that still covers Vanilla and Melantha. Lancet retains her demonstrated tile and direction.

Install Ansel before Steward, establishing eastern medical coverage.
Replace Vanilla with Spot on the same lower-central route tile.
Give GALLUS a separate lower-roadblock assignment, independent of Popukar's interception.
Establish Midnight's western upper interception and direct roadblock damage.
Replace Fang with Beagle after the fourth credited income grant.
Friston takes Popukar's lower-outer tile; Lava enters the upper artillery corridor.
Steward's released deployment slot funds permanent lower-central arts from 12F.
Melantha takes upper-outer responsibility after Midnight's clearance window.
Withdraw Durin and Friston; Cardigan receives lower-outer containment.
Noir Corne receives the final upper-outer officer after Melantha's two-officer window.
Replace Lava with redeployed Steward for upper-central clearance.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true; no reserve units.
DEPLOY tiles are integer [row,col] on appropriate terrain with explicit cardinal facing. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Only the listed fixed DEPLOY, ACTIVATE_SKILL and RETREAT actions execute. Predictions and phase conditions never delay actions or select replacements.
Require zero protected-target deaths and PROTECTED_TARGET_REACHED for both expected civilians. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block them.
Require actual DEVICE_DAMAGE and DEVICE_DESTROYED for roadblock #2. Popukar's deployment, facing and retreat do not establish clearance.
Credit artillery damage only from eligible ranged operators. Midnight and other melee operators contribute no flying-target damage in this runtime.
Maintain at most eight counted deployments and replace operators in the listed order. Preserve free central block capacity by damaging the old armor.
Every credited refund requires a successful living retreat. Released enemies and already-created shells remain active.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and both protected arrivals. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Preserve runner interceptions, eastern restraint destruction, living opening withdrawals and conditional income.
Damage both western restraints, maintain both outer officer interceptions, establish central defenders and charge medical skills.
Complete protected passage, sustain eastern-to-western artillery damage, protect medical recipients, and establish persistent lower-central arts.
Prevent either central defender from remaining full when the final armor arrives; complete both outer replacement sequences.
Clear every remaining hostile under sustained treatment; require both protected arrivals and full terminal acceptance.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income through the fourth grant only; no later grant credited.
Support lower shell exposure, mixed medical demand and prolonged lower armor clearance.
Strengthen eastern and final-return treatment, then sustain central clearance. Base range already covers the principal recipients.
Accelerate the first lower-outer officer pair; no obstacle clearance assumed.
Accelerate route-17 enemies and western upper roadblock clearance. No damage to flying artillery credited.
Reduce physical pressure; explicitly does not mitigate armored enemies' arts damage.
First burst supports the upper artillery crossing; second supports the final upper-central armor before withdrawal.
Use supported ordinary stats and output only. Exclude healing modes, self-heals, robot mitigation, resistance reduction, splash geometry, dodge and unsupported talents.

tactical_thesis: Preserve the four opening interceptions, establish mutually supported eastern treatment, and give Steward the artillery's long eastern circuit. Separate lower roadblock clearance from outer interception. Add western artillery damage and sustained lower-central arts before the final armor wave. This fixed-action proposal is unexecuted; artillery damage closure and medical allocation remain hypotheses requiring observed confirmation.
